title: The Ancient Heavenly Crocodile
summary: In the Sacred Spirit Pool, Lin Dong and Little Mink sense the remains of an Ancient Heavenly Crocodile at the bottom and dive for its essence blood, though the emperor has forbidden it. Lin Langtian follows, and the Yuan Spirit inside him fights Little Mink until the sealing formation breaks and Lin Langtian leaves Lin Dong to die. Lin Dong falls into an earth-fire vent, where the crocodile's remnant soul wakes in its skeleton. He distracts it while Little Mink drags the soul out and devours it, and Lin Dong takes the crocodile's bone spear Soul Treasure and essence blood. On the surface Lin Langtian has blamed him, but the emperor believes Lin Dong and lets him keep the spear. Little Flame starts evolving on the crocodile blood, and Ling Qingzhu's master sends her to the Ancient Battlefield.
events: The emperor sends the five into the Sacred Spirit Pool and forbids them to go to the bottom.
Lin Dong feels his Ancient Dragon Ape essence blood grow, and Little Mink senses a beast stronger than Nirvana below.
At the bottom Lin Langtian attacks; his inner Yuan Spirit fights Little Mink with the Energy Gathering Technique.
Lin Langtian's Great Heavenly Phoenix Seal meets Lin Dong's Great Desolate Ocean Splitting Seal and the formation breaks.
Lin Dong falls into an earth-fire vent and fights the crocodile skeleton with the Heavenly Scales Halberd Art.
Little Mink pulls out the remnant soul and absorbs it with Devouring Power; Lin Dong finds the crocodile's bone spear.
Lin Langtian blames Lin Dong; the emperor tells the crocodile's history and lets Lin Dong keep the spear.
Little Flame absorbs the crocodile blood, and Ling Qingzhu is sent to look into strange activity in the Ancient Battlefield.
cultivation: Little Mink says the Ancient Heavenly Crocodile was beyond Nirvana. Demon beasts that enter Nirvana and survive the Nirvana Tribulation can take human form. Little Flame begins evolving after taking the crocodile's essence blood.
